Compile all cable bills I have ever received over Gmail into a "bills.zip" and send it to him with a note, "PFA.", as a reply to that email. The files in zip should be named "MM-YYYY.pdf" as per the month it is the bill for.

The files in zip should be named "MM-YYYY.pdf" as per the month it is the bill for.
